sprint: Image Studio — background removal is no longer the default. Opening a picture in Image Studio now shows the ORIGINAL image on the Result view (Looks Great / Make It Better); the background-removal worker never auto-runs on open. Removal is on-demand only: the Edit view's sparkle tile (relabelled 'Remove Paper', matching the magic overlay's own 'Making the paper disappear...' language) kicks the removal on first tap — magic overlay and all — AND arms the erase brush, so once removal lands the child keeps refining by hand through the same tile. Brush strokes made while removal is still in flight are safe no-ops (the existing _workingBuffer guard). Applying straight from the Result view now hands back the untouched original.
task: Every downstream consumer (Place fill, stickers, Family Photos picks, background image, crop/rotate re-edits) is unaffected in mechanism — only the default changed. Cache-bust ?v=0326 -> ?v=0327.
